chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
When you pray behind an Imam who is not to be followed, then recite behind him, whether you hear his recitation or you do not hear.

key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, in the position of following in prayer
key_terms.لَا يُقْتَدَى بِهِ: one who is not to be followed as an Imam

ai.seo_question: Should you recite in salat when praying behind an Imam who is not to be followed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat performed behind an Imam who is not valid to follow in congregational prayer. It instructs the worshipper to recite personally behind such an Imam, regardless of whether the Imam's recitation is audible or inaudible.
